product.name: Pryzm Defense Intelligence Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates defense budget data, market intelligence, and relationship management to support government contracting and defense innovation.

product.name: Budget Intelligence
product.description: A tool providing access to detailed Department of Defense budget data across multiple categories for analysis and portfolio management.

identifier.value: Contextual Relationship Management (CRM) for National Security

product.name: Contextual Relationship Management (CRM) for National Security
product.description: A CRM platform designed to map, track, and manage relationships within the national security ecosystem using enriched contact data and visualization tools.

product.name: Orion™ Network Graph
product.description: An interactive network graph that consolidates data from budgets, CRMs, and research to visualize relationships and connections within the defense ecosystem.

product.name: Organization Intelligence
product.description: A service providing detailed intelligence on Department of Defense organizations, including leadership, contracts, and budget mappings.

product.name: Congressional Intelligence
product.description: A tool offering data and analysis on congressional committees, bills, voting histories, and staff to support legislative tracking and insight.
